baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated construct أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ joins ص ح ب to ي م ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: ص ح ب supplies sustained companionship while ي م ن supplies the right hand or side; repetition with مَا holds up a company constituted by that orientation for wonder.

activation_trace.role: Companionship and sustained association supply the collective relation named by أَصْحَٰب.
The right hand and right side supply the orientation that marks the company.

changed_reading.before: A conventional label, "companions of the right."
changed_reading.after: A fellowship whose defining association is with the right hand or side, repeated as an object of astonishment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَمِينِ can activate the blessing branch inside the twice-repeated company-name.
baseline_models.mechanism: The genitive relation lets blessing characterize the companionship itself, so the phrase can name a fortunate fellowship rather than only a spatially sorted class.

activation_trace.role: Companionship supplies a durable social grouping rather than a loose set.
Blessing and felicity supply the quality under which the fellowship is gathered.

changed_reading.before: The group is identified by a side.
changed_reading.after: The group is a fellowship marked by felicity and blessing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both focus roots have protective or force-bearing branches: preserved accompaniment in ص ح ب and power or right in ي م ن.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construct can couple preservation through accompaniment with an effective right or power, presenting the company as held and protected rather than merely placed.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment makes company a protective relation.
Power, right, and warding capacity make the qualifying "right" effective rather than merely directional.

changed_reading.before: A company located on the favorable side.
changed_reading.after: A company preserved by accompaniment and marked by an effective, protective right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus ي م ن inventory includes oath or covenant, while ص ح ب can denote making something accompany another.
baseline_models.mechanism: The construct can tentatively be heard as a company attended by a pledge: their identity is not only fortunate but bound to an accompanying assurance.

activation_trace.role: Making something accompany another supplies the relation by which an assurance could attend the company.
Oath and covenant supply the tentative pledged quality of the company.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a company accompanied by a binding assurance is announced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context unit turns blessing from a general favorable state into an operation on resistance: a harmful edge is removed without requiring the underlying thing to disappear.

activation_trace.role: The focus blessing branch supplies the favorable state being made concrete.
Removing thorns and breaking their sharpness supplies harm-neutralization as the first concrete function of blessing.

structural_cues: 56:28 places the خ ض د adjective directly on the opening item after the focus exclamation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies de-thorning or dulling; I infer that this exemplifies how focus blessing works. A live alternative is a purely botanical description with no general mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The right-company is blessed in an unspecified sense.
changed_reading.after: Its blessing begins as transformed usability: what could wound remains present but its injuring edge is neutralized.

context_deltas.mechanism: A branch of the ordered or stacked context word denotes a group by which a person gains strength; mapped back to أَصْحَاب and the power branch of يَمِين, it activates a company whose members reinforce one another.

activation_trace.role: Sustained companionship anchors the context image in the focus collective.
Power and effective right supply the capacity produced by the collective.
A group through which one gains strength supplies the mechanism of mutual reinforcement.

structural_cues: 56:29 places مَّنضُودٍ in the early provision sequence, where its arrangement image can also carry a social branch.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a strengthening-group branch within ن ض د; I map that social image onto the focus company. The live alternative is B001's purely material ordering.

changed_reading.before: أَصْحَاب names people who share a classification.
changed_reading.after: أَصْحَاب can name a coordinated company whose gathered arrangement itself produces strength.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shelter, connected extension, continuing flow, and the explicit denial of ending or withholding converge with the focus oath branch: the company's good is not a lucky instant but an assured, uninterrupted relation.

activation_trace.role: Preservation through accompaniment anchors continuity as a condition of the company.
Oath or covenant supplies the guarantee reading strengthened by the context.
Shelter and protective cover supply a continuing protected domain.
Connected increase that extends aid or material supplies ongoing replenishment.
Adherence and continuation make the poured provision durative rather than momentary.
Ending and disappearance are explicitly negated, blocking temporal termination.
Withholding the hand from giving is explicitly negated, blocking loss through a giver's refusal.

structural_cues: 56:30-33 chains provisions with repeated coordinators and closes with the paired negation لَّا ... وَلَا ....
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protection, extension, continuation, and negated ending or withholding; I infer a guarantee by convergence with focus ي م ن as oath. The live alternative is inexhaustible abundance without juridical force.

changed_reading.before: The pledged-company baseline is a form-distant possibility internal to ي م ن.
changed_reading.after: The sequence strengthens it into an assured relation: their provision is protected against both exhaustion and withholding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation, transformation into a state, firstness, loving affinity, and equality in age or companionship form a produced peer relation; أَصْحَاب therefore expands from a classified crowd into a deliberately constituted social world.

activation_trace.role: Companionship anchors the created and equal relations back in the focus noun.
Bringing something into being supplies deliberate social constitution.
Making something into a state supplies transformation rather than mere discovery.
The first or first-fruit image supplies renewed beginning.
Loving affinity supplies the affective bond within the produced social field.
Equality in age and companionship supplies peer symmetry rather than hierarchy.

structural_cues: 56:35-37 forms a creation-to-state-to-relation chain, followed immediately by the recipient phrase in 56:38.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies creation, state-change, firstness, love, and equal companionship; I infer that the assigned gifts include a constituted peer society. A live alternative limits the chain to particular feminine referents without redefining the wider company.

changed_reading.before: The companions are an already sorted aggregate.
changed_reading.after: Their good includes a newly constituted society of renewed, affectionate, equal companionship.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact focus title returns with prefixed لِ after the catalogue, converting the opening exclamation into an explicit beneficiary relation and binding the intervening sequence back to the company.

activation_trace.role: The repeated companionship term identifies the recipients of the preceding sequence.
The repeated blessing branch marks the beneficiary company as the same fortunate fellowship announced in 56:27.

structural_cues: The prefixed لِ in 56:38 turns the repeated focus phrase into a recipient phrase after 56:28-37.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition with beneficiary لِ; I let it scope backward over the catalogue. A live alternative restricts its scope to only the immediately preceding social description.

changed_reading.before: 56:27 is a self-contained title before a list.
changed_reading.after: 56:38 makes the title relational: the list is presented as arranged for that blessed fellowship.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two parallel assembled groups, one from those first and one from those later, distribute the singular focus designation across temporal positions; companionship is cohort-spanning rather than generation-bound.

activation_trace.role: The focus companionship branch supplies the shared designation carried by both cohorts.
An assembled group supplies the first collective realization of the company.
Beginning and precedence place one assembled group at the earlier temporal pole.
The repeated assembled-group image supplies a parallel later realization of the same company.
Laterness after the first places the second group at the other temporal pole.

structural_cues: 56:39 and 56:40 are parallel clauses differing chiefly in the first/later terms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel assembled groups at early and later poles; I infer that both instantiate the 56:38 recipients and thus revise the focus company into a cross-temporal designation. The live alternative treats them as two unrelated counts.

changed_reading.before: The companions sound like one contemporaneous body.
changed_reading.after: The title can gather distinct earlier and later cohorts into one blessed companionship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This shifts companionship from relations among people to relations between people and their environment, which is surprising; it remains anchored in focus ص ح ب B004 and in context branches of shelter, extension, and continuation. Render it only as a relational metaphor, not as a claim that the provisions are grammatically أَصْحَاب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ص ح ب B004 allows something to be made accompanying and continually carried with another.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing accompany another anchors the possibility that provision itself attends the company.
Protective shelter supplies an environmental accompaniment around the company.
Connected extension and aid make that accompaniment self-renewing.
Adherence and continuation keep the accompanying provision present.

changed_reading.before: The companions possess a favorable environment.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the favorable environment is made their constant companion, attending and preserving them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the non-dominant و ل ي mapping supplied for context ء و ل, so it is branch-distant and must not be stated as the lexical meaning of أَوَّلِينَ. It remains anchored in focus companionship, two assembled groups, explicit laterness, and the packet's succession branch; render it as a relay-like activation alongside, not instead of, the ordinary earlier/later reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated focus ص ح ب relation can be extended across the parallel cohorts of 56:39-40.

activation_trace.role: Making one thing accompany another supplies continuity between otherwise separate cohorts.
An assembled group supplies the first relay body.
The alternate mapped branch of one thing following another supplies relay-like succession.
The repeated assembled group supplies the succeeding relay body.
Laterness supplies the temporal separation across which succession operates.

changed_reading.before: Earlier and later companions are two static populations.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form successive bodies through which one companionship is carried forward.

strongest_changes: Blessing became an operation that neutralizes harm, not only a favorable label.
The context strengthened an oath-like reading into uninterrupted, unwithheld provision.
Companionship expanded into a deliberately created field of equal and affectionate peers.
The repeated beneficiary phrase and parallel cohorts made the company both context-binding and cross-temporal.
summary.what_was_special: The most generative activation came from reading material branches functionally: ن ض د supplied mutual reinforcement, negated ق ط ع and م ن ع made continuity guarantee-like, and the split ء و ل mapping preserved a contained succession outlier.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the oath branch of ي م ن carries real covenant force or only colors the rhetoric of inexhaustibility.
How broadly the feminine creation sequence should redefine the social constitution of أَصْحَاب.
Whether the non-dominant و ل ي mapping should survive beyond an explicitly exploratory relay model.
